title: The Muslim World Is Receiving the First Slap
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands) Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, laa ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa
lillahi 'l-hamd! (Mawlana Shaykh sits) ...Sayyidi 'l-awwaleen wa ’l-akhireen, Sayyidina Muhammad (s).
(Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) Wa man tabi`ahum bi-ihsaan ila Yawmi’ l-Qiyamah.
O People! We are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem.
O Our Attenders! I like that all of Mankind attend this speech on holy Friday, because it is for all Mankind,
not only for a handful of people. What we are saying is for all of Mankind and we gave our oath to our Lord,
Almighty Allah, (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) when we said, “You are our Creator!" When He asked,
"Am I not your Creator and Lord?" all the souls of Mankind were dressed with such a beautiful dressing that
you can't imagine! When they were in the Divine Presence on the Day of Promises, they said, "Yes, O our
Lord! You are our Creator!" When they said this, all of them were dressed with the dress of honor.
"Are you My servants? Do you accept My servanthood?"
All of them said, "Yes! You are our Lord and we are Your weak servants!"
"O My Servants! To be dressed with My servanthood is the highest point of honor in Creation, and I dressed

you with it also."
At that time all of us were dressed with the dress of honor of Heavens, but then what happened? Madad, yaa
Sultan al-Awliya. Some of them kept their oaths, saying, "We are Your servants," and that holy dress stayed
on them. Those who did not keep their oath when they came to this life and forgot they had been dressed in
that dress of honor said, "We are not servants, we are lords!"
That is someone's claim when they forget that oath and say they are not servants, "We do not accept to be
servants." Therefore, their bad and worst teacher, Shaytan, is saying, "Yes, I am leading you to an honor that
you may forget your servanthood and every one of you will say, 'I am this one. I am a king, admiral, field
marshal, prime minister, president.'"
(If we ask,) “How did you become president?” (they reply,) "Because people voted that I am not a servant, I
am your special one and you are my servants! I am president of your headquarters."
(If we ask,) “Who gave you this honor?” (they reply,) "My people."
From the beginning up to the end, Shaytan is trying to make people not accept that they are servants to the
Lord of Heavens! Then Allah Almighty says, "I am looking at what is happening to you when you lose your
oath to Me." What is happening? Those people are making all citizens of their nations not be servants. There
is honor for servants, but there is no honor when they make those people slaves and deputies of Shaytan!
Who is doing that? The president of Egypt, a dictator in Libya, a dictator in Turkey, a dictator in Damascus, a
dictator in Yemen! (Allah is saying,) “You are not accepting to be servants for Allah Almighty, your Creator,
so now I am making you slaves or representatives of Shaytan!”
All dictators and tyrants are representatives of Shaytan, and when people say, "We are fed up with you, go
away, we must look after ourselves," they say, "How are you saying this? Bring new weapons, new nuclear
bombs, new planes to use against those people who are not accepting me as their lord, and kill them!" And
they are killed. It is so clear; those dictators are saying, "I am here. I am your lord, and you must be obedient
to me or I will kill all of you."
That is the trouble now throughout the east and west. It is particularly a big shame for the Muslim world,

because Allah Almighty ordered them to keep one person as sultan of the entire Muslim community. And
(since the last sultan was removed) Muslim people have now reached the highest levels of ignorance! People
are now saying (to their dictators), "We are not going to obey you," and the deputies and representatives of
Shaytan are saying, "This throne is only for me and all of you are my servants! If you do not obey me I will kill
all of you and take everything away!"
That is an autopsy of nations and their citizens, and it is one-hundred percent accurate. The Lord of Heavens
is saying to Sayyidi 'l-awwaleen wa ’l-`akhireen, the Seal of Prophets (s), "O My Beloved! Don't think that I
have given a chance to a handful of people to be like Pharaohs or Nimrods, no! All Mankind to whom I give
the chance to be number one, like Qaddafi, will go away and another one will come. If you give someone a
chance to be your leader or your “Number One” and you submit to him, he is only going to be like his
predecessor. There was a Pharaoh or Nimrod before him and if you replace them, you will find him to be the
same as the previous one.”
Therefore, now all states of Arabs, Turks and other nations are saying, "We must change our constitution and
bring another one," but people are no-mind now. The Lord of Heavens’ Words are the most perfect and true
words coming from Heavens. If you keep the same ways, you will reach what your ancestors reached.
O People! Only if you keep the heavenly rules from the Lord of Heavens will you be able save yourselves from
dragons and Nimrods. If you bring a new constitution, they will ask to keep that most sensible point in their
hands and will only put some new rules. To their people they say, "That is best," while keeping the same
sensible point in their hands; that is how they continue to cheat the people! They never accept heavenly rules,
saying, "We can't accept heavenly rules, we must make our own rules."
The one who is saying this is certified and graduated by Shaytan: don’t believe him! Whoever says, "We are
bringing new rules," is a student of Shaytan, who trains them to cheat people; therefore, the same troubles to
come on them (as with their previous leaders), so they are not accepting.
(Mawlana Shaykh stands) Allah Almighty has said:
••••• •••••• •••••••• ••••••••••• •••••••••••••
inn ’Allaha yaamuru bi’l-`adli wa’l-ihsaan. Allah commands justice, the doing of good, (Surat an-Nahl, 16:90)

(Mawlana Shaykh sits) `Adil, real justice is what has been sent from Heavens to chosen ones, to prophets.
Now all nations are refusing prophets, particularly in the Muslim world. I am sorry to say Shaytan also cheats
them and they are not accepting heavenly laws, saying, "We are bringing a new constitution."
We are not accepting (your new constitution)! We are Muslims and we are not accepting what they are
bringing according to their selfish desires, no! Therefore, there is no result for Egypt, Sham, Yemen, Iran,
Iraq, Turkey, Tunis, Algeria, and other Muslim states. It is not haqq that there should be more than one
authority in the Islamic world! Why is the Muslim world divided in so many groups? Allah Almighty ordered
there must be one imaam, one sultan! Before everything, Muslims must have a khalifah who has power over
the whole Muslim world.
And yet the whole world fears the Chinese government because its citizens are obedient to only one person.
Why are Muslims not obeying the laws of Allah Almighty?
Therefore, the first slap will be on the Muslim world, and now you are seeing what is happening in the
Islamic world, one after the other. I am sorry that Egypt is saying, "We are the center of religious authority,
authorized to speak about Islam." I am asking, what is Islam saying to you? Where is Shari`ah? Why did
Allah Almighty bring the Shari`ah? Are you not ashamed to say, "We are authorities on Islam." How (can you
say this)? Shari`ah orders you that what everyone brings is according to their selfish desires. Therefore, a
slap is coming one after one on the Islamic world until they submit to the imaam, the sultan of Islam, and it is
not going to be a full reality (to them) until Sayyidina Mahdi (a) comes!
O People! Those who are not taking care, people who are listening and hearing will take one slap, and those
who are not taking care will take one-hundred slaps! Until they accept one imaam, they will like Haroot and
Maroot, who did not keep heavenly orders and, therefore, were punished with their heads down and their feet
up! The Lord of Heavens punished them to be thirsty ones and between their mouth and water were four
fingers, ten centimeters. They were so thirsty, but they couldn't reach the water until they kept heavenly
orders, then they will be able to drink.
Now the whole Islamic world is in this state! Allah Almighty is giving such clear examples that just happened.
Yaa Rabbee, shukr! But Muslims and their leaders are not accepting heavenly orders, saying, "We are going

to make a new constitution." Allah is making them like Haroot and Maroot. Leave them to look after their
constitutions!
O Arabs! Listen! You are the first ones who will be punished and you are seeing that heavenly punishment is
beginning with Arab governments: Algeria, Tunis, Libya, Egypt, Sudan, Sham, Palestine, Iraq, Bahrain, and
Yemen; the first slaps are coming on them. They will find within forty days what will happen to those who
insist to go against Shari`atullah, bringing parliaments and members of parliament; they will be taken by
their heads. The first punishment is on Arabs and you are seeing that the Arab world is under heavy
punishment now. (Nothing will change) until one of them stands up to say, "I am bringing the heavenly rules
of Allah Almighty that He sent to us for our true lives here and forever in Paradise."
May Allah forgive us! This is an ocean that cannot finish in one or two hours, one or two days, one or two
months, or one or two years, but it is enough for you if you think on it. Those who are not thinking, a
heavenly slap will come on their heads!
••••• •••••• ••• ••••••••• ••• •••••••• •••••• •••••••••••• ••• ••••••••••••••
inn ’Allaha la yughayyiru ma bi-qawmin hatta yughayyiru maa bi-anfusihim. Verily never will Allah change
the condition of a people until they change it themselves (with their own souls). (Surat ar-Ra`d, 13:11)
Until servants accept the right way, the heavenly constitution of Shari`atullah, they will be slapped and
punished, which will never finish until they accept the Holy Qur'an's constitution.
O People! Keep your adab. Keep your faith with Allah Almighty and with His Holy Prophet (s), and you will
be happy here and Hereafter. May Allah forgive us.
Fatihah.
